introHtml: Fleece personal protection equipment combines warmth with safety for outdoor workers and cold-weather environments. Unlike standard PPE, fleece options like the Winterdana provide neck and face coverage without sacrificing breathability. Ideal for construction sites, utility crews, or event staff, these items can be decorated with your logo using screen printing or embroidery. Choose fleece for comfortable, branded protection that your team will actually want to wear.
